# mokhaLab

> mokhaLab designs precision coffee tools — tampers, WDT distributors, and accessories — built for the daily ritual of specialty coffee. Tools are available on Amazon in the US and Canada.

mokhaLab products are designed with restraint: every element that doesn't serve the hand or the cup is removed. Materials are chosen for how they age, not just how they perform on day one.

## Products

- [Products](https://www.mokhalab.com/products): Full catalogue of mokhaLab coffee tools
